title: Everyday Phrases — Riding a Driverless Taxi
scene_zh: 無人計程車 · 情境對話
title_quote: Is this a taxi without a driver?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🚕 實用「搭乘無人計程車」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡800句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Riding a Driverless Taxi
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「搭乘無人計程車」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景跟著一輛無人計程車走完一趟：在手機 App 裡挑車、設定上車點、走到地上的藍色方框、輸入四位解鎖碼開門、坐進後座讓車自己起步、在螢幕上選路線、認清車裡每一顆按鈕、遇到繞路重算也不慌，最後到點評分、給小費、存好收據，再跟小車揮手道別。800 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。常用句型包含問車子怎麼用、確認上車點與路線、詢問費用與評分。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Riding a Driverless Taxi' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). The scene follows one driverless ride end to end: picking a robot taxi in the app, saving the meeting point, walking to the painted square, typing the four-digit door code, feeling the car start on its own, choosing a route on the screen, learning every button inside, staying calm through a reroute, then rating the trip, adding a tip, keeping the receipt and waving goodbye. 800 lines on loop, CEFR A2, easy for beginners. #EnglishListening #SleepEnglish #LearnEnglish

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this a taxi without a driver?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs ə ˈtæksi wɪˈðaʊt ə ˈdraɪvər?/
dialogue.zh: 這是沒有司機的計程車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pick one in the app?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ pɪk wən ɪn ði æp?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在介面裡挑一台嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 兩個感應器會看著路面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far is the car now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask for a stop?
dialogue.zh: 我能要求中途停一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, add it on the map.
dialogue.zh: 可以，在地圖上加一個點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a seat here?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the app know my address?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What name is on the car?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It shows a short car code.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you are the only guest.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A helper in an office can see.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈhɛlpər ɪn ən ˈɔːfɪs kæn siː./
dialogue.zh: 辦公室裡的人能看到車內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why can I not stop closer?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼不能停在近一點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 無人車只能停在指定點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do we wait here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The car arrives in four minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I change my mind later?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ tʃeɪndʒ maɪ maɪnd ˈleɪtər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可以，車到之前取消就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay to cancel it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No fee if you are quick.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write the car code on paper.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is the road to us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It will wait at that point.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the roof lamp knows you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It shows your last two digits.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bag space opens by itself.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay before the ride?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app pays when we arrive.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, only card in the app.
dialogue.zh: 不行，只能用介面裡的卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It can grow if we reroute.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The car picks a new road.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the car is moving now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app shows it all the time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp ʃoʊz ɪt ɔl ðə taɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which street do we wait on?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The corner by the red shop.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: While waiting, may I sit down?
dialogue.zh: 等的時候可以坐一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a bench at the point.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə bɛntʃ æt ðə pɔɪnt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How will I know it is here?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ wɪl aɪ noʊ ɪt ɪz hɪr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is only a notice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I open the app again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, your door code is in there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs jɔːr dɔːr koʊd ɪz ɪn ðɛr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The code that opens the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A new code for each car.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my friend use my phone?
dialogue.zh: 我朋友能用我的手機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Each phone gets its own ride.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many can ride with me?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I choose at the door?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the door stays closed?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I ready to go outside?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, first save the meeting point.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I walk to the point now?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ wɔːk tə ðə pɔɪnt naʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the car cannot stop here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far do I have to walk?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ fɑːr du aɪ hæv tə wɔːk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the point on this street?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one with the tall pole.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I cross here or there?
dialogue.zh: 我在這裡過馬路還是那邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the app says walk closer.
dialogue.zh: 你看，介面上說再走近一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I stand in the road?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ stænd ɪn ðə roʊd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不行，走在人行道邊就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The car only sees marked spots.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By the gate next to the café.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə ɡeɪt nɛkst tə ðə kæˈfeɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我一個人站在這裡等嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the point fits only four.
dialogue.zh: 對，那個點只能站四個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is a man with a dog.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ə mæn wɪð ə dɔːɡ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He can wait at the next point.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi kæm weɪt æt ðə nɛkst pɔɪnt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the spot marked on the ground?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə spɑːt mɑːrkt ɑn ðə ɡraʊnd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a blue square with a P.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə blu skwɛr wɪð ə pi./
dialogue.zh: 有，一個藍色方塊還有 P。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I do not see the square.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The car is slow in this area.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑːr ɪz sloʊ ɪn ðɪs ˈɛriə./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I wait with my back to it?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ weɪt wɪð maɪ bæk tə ɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The roof needs to see you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I hold up my phone?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, your door code will do.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right here, the street is loud.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, cars pass all the time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then that is the right one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It stops so far from me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move to the line, it will see.
dialogue.phonetic: /muːv tə ðə laɪn ɪt wɪl si./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, can the car come right here?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kæn ðə kɑːr kʌm raɪt hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 所以車能直接開到我這邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you go to the point.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only a taxi with a driver can do that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ə ˈtæksi wɪð ə ˈdraɪvər kæm duː ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 只有有司機的計程車才肯這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A bike is in my way.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Step aside, do not push it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I stand near the gate?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not too near, the car needs room.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑːt tu nɪr ðə kɑːr niːdz ruːm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two clear meters on each side.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a car parked there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then use the square after it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone says you are late.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am two steps away, sorry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn left at the next wall.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here I am, by the pole.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the car knows you now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No need, just stay in place.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the lamp shows your digits.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It looks like a waiting room.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go to the door you chose.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap the light strip on the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp ðə laɪt strɪp ɑn ðə dɔːr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, it glows but the door stays.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɪt ɡloʊz bʌt ðə dɔːr steɪz./
dialogue.zh: 啊，它發亮了，可是門沒有開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the code opens it first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The back seat takes it fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: People on the street are looking.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They look at every robot car.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我現在喜歡在這裡等了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next time pick a shaded point.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honestly, that walk was not hard.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the first time feels long.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the app count my steps?
dialogue.zh: 介面上有計算我的步數嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it logs the walk to the point.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt lɔɡz ðə wɔːk tə ðə pɔɪnt./
dialogue.zh: 有，它會記錄你走到點的距離。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, the pad needs the code.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑːt jɛt ðə pæd niːdz ðə koʊd./
dialogue.zh: 還不行，門邊鍵盤要先輸入。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I type the code?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the small pad by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə smɔːl pæd baɪ ðə dɔːr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it lit in the dark?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 看得見，按鍵會微微發亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the keys on this side?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the code from your screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, the wind blew the paper away.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ðə wɪnd blu ðə ˈpeɪpər əˈweɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then use the code in the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn juz ðə koʊd ɪn ði æp./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait a bit, then type it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 大部分的人一開始都會錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one on the street side.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 它會先看有沒有腳踏車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on, this door will not move.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn ðɪs dɔːr wɪl nɑːt muːv./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 感應器會在意你的安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The code links to your phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then, may I share the code?
dialogue.zh: 那麼這碼我能給別人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it works for you only.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is made for rain.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I lose my phone?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a code in your email.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə koʊd ɪn jɔːr ˈiˌmeɪl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, look at the small lens.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means the door is free.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ask on the inside screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just now, the door closed on my bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst naʊ ðə dɔːr kloʊzd ɑn maɪ bæɡ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull the strap out and try.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I press a button to close?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ prɛs ə ˈbʌtən tə kloʊz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it closes on its own.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But now it is closed well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the code hidden after typing?
dialogue.zh: 輸入後碼會被遮起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then, could someone change my code?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use your fingertip, not a nail.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then use the flat of a finger.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn juz ðə flæt əv ə ˈfɪŋɡər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I have to be fast?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you have a full minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is your sign to enter.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the driver seat off limits?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the door closes behind you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It did, the ride can start.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Suddenly, the seat moved under me.
dialogue.zh: 突然，座椅在我身下動了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sets itself to your back.
dialogue.zh: 它會自己調整貼住你的背。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it checks that you are safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt tʃɛks ðæt ju ɑːr seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 對，它在確認你安不安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: With a soft click, the door slid shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪð ə sɔːft klɪk ðə dɔːr slɪd ʃʌt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the car woke up quietly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the wheel turned on its own.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ðə wiːl tɜːrnd ɑn ɪts oʊn./
dialogue.zh: 你看，方向盤自己轉起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can hear my own breath.
dialogue.zh: 我連自己的呼吸都聽得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 車裡太安靜，你就會開始細聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sees the lamps, like eyes.
dialogue.zh: 它會看號誌，像眼睛一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It heats in the cold season.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I move my seat back?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask the screen on your side.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How does a seat move without me?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dəz ə siːt muːv wɪˈðaʊt mi?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small motor sits in it.
dialogue.zh: 座椅裡裝了小小的馬達。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 車裡有空氣可以呼吸嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fan blows from the top.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And just like that, it turned left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd dʒʌst laɪk ðæt ɪt tɜːrnd lɛft./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soft music came on by itself.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is just the ride music.
dialogue.zh: 那是行程配的背景音樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, may I turn it off?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside, the light changed to red.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold on, the road is steep.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A far office may guide it.
dialogue.zh: 遠處的辦公室可能會引導。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One helper may watch many cars.
dialogue.zh: 一個支援人員看好幾輛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The screen shows it, low and steady.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skriːn ʃoʊz ɪt loʊ ənd ˈstɛdi./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the park is on top.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I look out the window?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the view is nice here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A dog ran by the car.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It slowed to let the dog pass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sloʊd tə lɛt ðə dɔɡ pæs./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bag slid off the seat.
dialogue.zh: 我的包從座位滑下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it, the floor is clean.
dialogue.zh: 先讓它放著，地板很乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it okay to stand up here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt oʊˈkeɪ tə stænd ʌp hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在這裡站起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 硬一點的座椅比較撐背。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six more turns, then we are near.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks mɔːr tɜːrnz ðɛn wi ɑːr nɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A big turn is coming up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel like a guest pilot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ahead, a bus made us slow down.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈhɛd ə bʌs meɪd ʌs sloʊ daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 前方有輛公車，讓車放慢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps space from big cars.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It plans for all street users.
dialogue.zh: 它會把街上的人都算進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the way, the inside light is dim.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə weɪ ði ɪnˈsaɪd laɪt ɪz dɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I sit and do nothing?
dialogue.zh: 我就坐著什麼都不做嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is all a rider does.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a note, nothing is wrong.
dialogue.zh: 只是通知而已，沒有出錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I did not check my phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the screen calls this seat yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə skriːn kɔːlz ðɪs siːt jɔːrz./
dialogue.zh: 現在螢幕把這座位算成你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你的碼開過門，它就知道是你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On the screen, a map appears.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I ask for a new road?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ æsk fər ə nuː roʊd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那條河邊的路看起來很美。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 今天先求快，下次再賞景。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the car knows the change.
dialogue.zh: 這樣車就知道要換路了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if I change my mind again?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf aɪ tʃeɪndʒ maɪ maɪnd əˈɡɛn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, any time before the turn.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I add a stop?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, the screen shows it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 點那個安靜路線的標籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, a blue dot on the map.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ə blu dɑːt ɑn ðə mæp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I see the next turn?
dialogue.zh: 我能看到下一個轉彎嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swipe the map with one finger.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It shows left in two blocks.
dialogue.zh: 它顯示兩個街口後左轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask it to hurry?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says your name is saved.
dialogue.zh: 上面說你的名字存好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I watch the map move?
dialogue.zh: 我可以看著地圖移動嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that is the fun part.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It asks if I am sure.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A new route is faster now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this the way you like?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the map is clear here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At last, the screen shows my stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt læst ðə skriːn ʃoʊz maɪ stɑːp./
dialogue.zh: 終於，螢幕顯示我的站了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It marks the turns for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap the bell at the top.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bell will warn you first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is cheaper than a taxi.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 沒有司機，也沒有額外費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And here the map shows a long line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd hɪr ðə mæp ʃoʊz ə lɔːŋ laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 然後地圖上出現一條長線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is all of your route.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I zoom in on it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pin sits at the gate.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, there is time to spare.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這條路線我能存起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This round button, what is it?
dialogue.zh: 這個圓的按鈕是做什麼的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, only in a real need.
dialogue.zh: 不用，只有真的需要才按。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does this flat key do?
dialogue.zh: 這個平平的鍵是做什麼的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It asks the car to wait.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For you, if you step out.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So it will not leave me?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How bright is it right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one has a fan mark.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only a small hum, nothing loud.
dialogue.zh: 只有一點小小的嗡嗡聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That calls a person far away.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有，一個負責協助車的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do I say to them?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just your seat and the problem.
dialogue.zh: 說出你的座位跟問題就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This square one has no mark.
dialogue.zh: 這個方方的沒有任何標誌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one opens the window shade.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too much sun in my eyes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is this small hole here?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的手機在這裡會發熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set it in that small hole.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one wire under the seat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does this lamp mark do?
dialogue.zh: 這個燈的標誌是做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It turns the inside light on.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the key, do not tap.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this one only for show?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it opens the bag space.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it waits for you there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the red line key?
dialogue.zh: 那條紅線旁的鍵是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not touch that one ever.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is that one so bad?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It wakes a big alarm sound.
dialogue.zh: 它會引出很大的警報聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then rest it on the pad.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a pad for cups?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask the car a word?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æsk ðə kɑːr ə wɜːrd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the key with a mouth.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It means you may talk now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say slow, say stop, say home.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This last one is a switch.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It makes the screen go dark.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is calm in the dark.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, dark is what sleep likes.
dialogue.zh: 對啊，睡覺就喜歡暗下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I use all the keys?
dialogue.zh: 我把所有鍵都用過了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You mean the one by my foot?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju miːn ðə wʌn baɪ maɪ fʊt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 小事加起來就是一趟車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All at once, the road changed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The car saw a jam ahead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A jam? I see none here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It knows from far up the street.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt noʊz frəm fɑːr ʌp ðə striːt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the map made a new plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə mæp meɪd ə nuː plæn./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，地圖重新排了計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Up top, the screen says new route.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌp tɑːp ðə skriːn sɛz nuː ruːt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is not sure of one road.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪt ɪz nɑːt ʃʊr ɑːv wʌn roʊd./
dialogue.zh: 不是，它只是拿不準一條路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Outside, the car is turning right.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the long side road.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It picks the way with few stops.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt pɪks ðə weɪ wɪð fjuː stɑːps./
dialogue.zh: 它挑紅綠燈最少的那條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did it talk to other cars?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cars share the road news.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is new for the car too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz nuː fər ðə kɑːr tuː./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Around us, the street has trees.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look at the shade, how thick.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we stay on this road?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it joins the main way.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The car sped up a bit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The road lets it go there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back on screen, the clock counts down.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk ɑn skriːn ðə klɑːk kaʊnts daʊn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the new plan is fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It drives slow in wet streets.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So it may take more time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and it made no sound.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It did stop, right at the line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dɪd stɑːp raɪt æt ðə laɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So far, the plan changed twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But we are still on time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask why we moved?
dialogue.zh: 我能問我們為什麼改道嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap the road line on screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says a lane is closed.
dialogue.zh: 上面寫有一個車道封閉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the car found a back way.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə kɑːr faʊnd ə bæk weɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The car counts all of them.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps the roads you like.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it will pick it more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, a red dot on the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ə rɛd dɑːt ɑn ðə skriːn./
dialogue.zh: 你看，螢幕上有一個紅點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A slow part, one block long.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask it to avoid that?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æsk ɪt tə əˈvɔɪd ðæt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is already in the plan.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I ride two times a week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The car went around a fair.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Crowds make it pick wide roads.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 現在是我們那條街了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still we came at the right time.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl wiː keɪm æt ðə raɪt taɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The screen shows the new plan.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only full, not bad at all.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The car does not hide much.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right on time, the car stopped.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, the curb is high here.
dialogue.zh: 小心，這裡的路緣比較高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the screen asks for a rating.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə skriːn æskz fər ə ˈreɪtɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say so, it helps the car.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No driver reads, the team does.
dialogue.zh: 沒有司機在看，是那個團隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the team sees my words?
dialogue.zh: 那團隊會看到我寫的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I skip the rating?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, skip with the small X.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, a little care goes far.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it asks for a tip.
dialogue.zh: 現在它問要不要給小費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It pays the crew that cleans cars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt peɪz ðə kru ðæt kliːnz kɑrz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the night check crew.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is a good tip?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app pays it from your card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp peɪz ɪt frəm jɔːr kɑːrd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will do it now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The receipt comes to your mail.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, the door will close now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See, the car is pulling away.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It goes for the next guest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, the tip box was easy.
dialogue.zh: 說真的，給小費那格很簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Later, may I change my rating?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 能改一次，在行程清單裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 在右上角你的大頭照下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The stars sit in a row.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app kept the price low.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 裡面沒有藏起來的費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last thing, the screen says ride over.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst θɪŋ ðə skriːn sɛz raɪd ˈoʊvər./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your old code is done now.
dialogue.zh: 你那組舊碼現在沒用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So a new code next time?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, what is on your mind?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, may I thank the car?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say it, the mic may hear.
dialogue.zh: 你說，麥克風可能聽得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 車頂燈綠色的閃了一下。
